--- title: "11 · Genome Coverage Depth" subtitle: "Per-position sequencing depth with gene annotations and DPI comparison" description: | Aggregates per-base sequencing depth across replicates grouped by days post-infection (DPI). Produces a log-scale depth profile with gene boundary markers and SEM ribbons, using the Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette. categories: [genomics, virology, coverage, sequencing] jupyter: python3 --- ## Overview | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Input** | `coverage.csv` · `gene_coords.csv` · `manifest.csv` (generated by `data/simulate_data.py`) | | **Key packages** | `pandas`, `numpy`, `matplotlib` | | **Statistics** | Mean depth ± SEM per position (aggregated across replicates) | | **Output** | Coverage depth profile (PNG + SVG) with gene annotations · aggregated summary CSV | | **Download** | [template.ipynb](template.ipynb) | [← Gallery](../../index.html){.btn .btn-outline-secondary} [Download .ipynb](template.ipynb){.btn .btn-primary} --- ## User Configuration ::: {#user-config .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} # ── USER CONFIGURATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Data directory (relative to this notebook) DATA_DIR = "data" # Output directory for figures and summary tables OUTPUT_DIR = "outputs" # Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette (mapped to DPI values in display order) DPI_COLORS = { 1: "#E69F00", # orange 3: "#56B4E9", # sky blue 5: "#009E73", # bluish green } DPI_ORDER = [1, 3, 5] # Figure dimensions (inches) FIG_WIDTH = 12 FIG_HEIGHT = 5 # Figure DPI for PNG raster output FIG_DPI = 300 # Log scale toggle (True = log10 y-axis) LOG_SCALE = True # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ``` ::: ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import os import warnings import numpy as np import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt warnings.filterwarnings("ignore") os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) # ── Publication‑ready matplotlib style (white bg, no grid, black spines) ───── plt.rcParams.update({ "axes.facecolor": "white", "figure.facecolor": "white", "savefig.facecolor": "white", "axes.grid": False, "axes.edgecolor": "black", "axes.linewidth": 0.8, "xtick.color": "black", "ytick.color": "black", "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "font.family": "sans-serif", "font.sans-serif": ["Arial", "DejaVu Sans"], "font.size": 10, "axes.titlesize": 12, "axes.labelsize": 11, "xtick.labelsize": 9, "ytick.labelsize": 9, "legend.fontsize": 9, "legend.frameon": False, "figure.dpi": 100, "savefig.dpi": 300, "savefig.bbox": "tight", }) print(f"Output will be saved to: {os.path.abspath(OUTPUT_DIR)}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Output will be saved to: \Documents\GitHub_Repos\lab-bioinfo-templates\templates\12_coverage-depth-analysis\outputs ``` ::: ::: ## Load Data ::: {#cell-load-data .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} cov = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "coverage.csv")) genes = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "gene_coords.csv")) manifest = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "manifest.csv")) print(f"Coverage: {len(cov):,} rows · {cov['sample_id'].nunique()} samples") print(f"Genes: {len(genes)} annotated features") print(f"Manifest: {len(manifest)} samples across {manifest['dpi'].nunique()} DPI groups") cov.head(5) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Coverage: 103,023 rows · 9 samples Genes: 9 annotated features Manifest: 9 samples across 3 DPI groups ``` ::: ::: {#load-data .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Aggregate Depth by DPI ::: {#cell-aggregate-depth .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} agg = ( cov.groupby(["dpi", "Position"])["Depth"] .agg(["mean", "sem", "count"]) .reset_index() ) print(f"Aggregated depth table: {len(agg)} rows (position × DPI)") agg.head(8) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Aggregated depth table: 34341 rows (position × DPI) ``` ::: ::: {#aggregate-depth .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {#check-dpi-groups .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} for dpi_val in DPI_ORDER: sub = agg[agg["dpi"] == dpi_val] n_reps = manifest[manifest["dpi"] == dpi_val]["replicate"].nunique() print( f" DPI {dpi_val}: {n_reps} replicates, " f"mean depth = {sub['mean'].mean():.0f} ± {sub['sem'].mean():.0f} SEM " f"(n={sub['count'].iloc[0]} replicates per position)" ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` DPI 1: 3 replicates, mean depth = 7232 ± 577 SEM (n=3 replicates per position) DPI 3: 3 replicates, mean depth = 7231 ± 579 SEM (n=3 replicates per position) DPI 5: 3 replicates, mean depth = 7236 ± 578 SEM (n=3 replicates per position) ``` ::: ::: ## Coverage Depth Plot ::: {#cell-coverage-plot .cell fig-height='5' fig-width='12' execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_WIDTH, FIG_HEIGHT)) # ── Gene boundary vertical lines and labels ─────────────────────────────────── for _, gene in genes.iterrows(): ax.axvline(gene["start"], color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5) ax.axvline(gene["end"], color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5) midpoint = (gene["start"] + gene["end"]) / 2 ax.annotate( gene["gene"], xy=(midpoint, 1.02), xycoords=("data", "axes fraction"), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7, fontstyle="italic", color="grey", ) # ── Alternating gene background shading ─────────────────────────────────────── for i, (_, gene) in enumerate(genes.iterrows()): if i % 2 == 0: ax.axvspan(gene["start"], gene["end"], alpha=0.04, color="grey", zorder=0) # ── Depth curves with SEM ribbons ───────────────────────────────────────────── genome_start = agg["Position"].min() genome_end = agg["Position"].max() for dpi_val in DPI_ORDER: sub = agg[agg["dpi"] == dpi_val].sort_values("Position") color = DPI_COLORS[dpi_val] ax.plot( sub["Position"], sub["mean"], color=color, linewidth=1.2, label=f"DPI {dpi_val}", zorder=2, ) ax.fill_between( sub["Position"], sub["mean"] - sub["sem"], sub["mean"] + sub["sem"], color=color, alpha=0.15, linewidth=0, zorder=1, ) # ── Axes and labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ax.set_xlim(genome_start, genome_end) ax.set_xlabel("Genomic position (nt)") if LOG_SCALE: ax.set_yscale("log") ax.set_ylabel("Depth (log₁₀ scale)") # Trim y to reasonable log bounds y_min = max(10, agg["mean"].min() * 0.5) y_max = agg["mean"].max() * 1.3 ax.set_ylim(y_min, y_max) else: ax.set_ylabel("Sequencing depth") ax.set_ylim(0, agg["mean"].max() * 1.15) ax.set_title( "Genome Coverage Depth by DPI\n" f"({len(manifest['sample_id'].unique())} samples · mean ± SEM across replicates)", fontsize=12, pad=14, ) ax.legend( title=f"DPI (n={manifest.groupby('dpi')['sample_id'].nunique().to_dict()})", loc="upper right", frameon=False, ) # ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── for fmt in ["png", "svg"]: out_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"coverage_depth.{fmt}") fig.savefig(out_path, format=fmt, dpi=FIG_DPI) print(f"Saved: {os.path.abspath(out_path)}") plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved: \Documents\GitHub_Repos\lab-bioinfo-templates\templates\12_coverage-depth-analysis\outputs\coverage_depth.png Saved: \Documents\GitHub_Repos\lab-bioinfo-templates\templates\12_coverage-depth-analysis\outputs\coverage_depth.svg ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](template_files/figure-html/coverage-plot-output-2.png){#coverage-plot width=999 height=495} ::: ::: ## Summary Export ::: {#cell-summary-export .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} agg.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "coverage_depth_summary.csv"), index=False) print(f"Saved: {os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, 'coverage_depth_summary.csv')}") # Per-DPI genome-wide summary per_dpi = ( agg.groupby("dpi") .agg( mean_depth=("mean", "mean"), median_depth=("mean", "median"), min_depth=("mean", "min"), max_depth=("mean", "max"), mean_sem=("sem", "mean"), ) .round(1) ) per_dpi ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved: outputs\coverage_depth_summary.csv ``` ::: ::: {#summary-export .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=8} ```{=html}
